title: Real-Time Combat & Tactical Pause
summary: Battles in Thornvael unfold in real time, yet discipline beats frantic clicking. Press Spacebar at any moment to freeze the field, inspect enemy armor, queue healing wards, and redirect vulnerable archers. Use Auto-Pause triggers in Settings to halt the clock automatically when an ally drops below 25% health or unseen ambushers emerge from fog.

summary: Left-click to select individual fighters, drag a box to group your squad, or press the Select All key to move as one company. title: Protagonist Classes & Roles
summary: Your protagonist anchors every expedition across Thornvael. title: Core Attributes & Derived Stats
summary: Each level grants attribute points to distribute among Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, and Vitality. Strength boosts melee damage and heavy armor threshold; Dexterity sharpens accuracy, evasion, and critical strikes; Intelligence expands mana pools and spell potency; Vitality increases maximum health and bleed resistance.

title: Skill Specializations & Respec
summary: Every class commands three distinct specialization branches unlocked by investing points in earlier tiers. title: Armor, Penetration & Damage Types
summary: Flat armor subtracts directly from incoming physical hits, making lightly armed levies nearly helpless against knightly plate. Counter heavy armor with picks, arbalests, armor-sundering strikes, or elemental magic. Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Astral damage bypass physical plate and test specific elemental resistances instead.

title: Status Ailments & Crowd Control
summary: Battlefields are won by denying enemy actions. Stun interrupts casting and drops shield blocks; Chill slows movement and attack cadence; Frozen targets shatter under heavy blunt blows; Bleed and Poison bypass armor over time. Keep cleansing draughts or ward-casters ready to strip lethal hexes.

title: Company Morale & March Fatigue
summary: Mercenaries are hired hands, not mindless zealots. Watching comrades fall, running low on silver, or suffering unhealed wounds erodes morale, risking panic or desertion. Long marches without rest also accumulate fatigue, reducing accuracy and speed until your squad recovers at a town tavern or camp.

summary: Visit regional taverns, garrison posts, and border camps to inspect available mercenaries. Each hire requires an upfront signing fee and deducts weekly upkeep after completed missions. Repeatedly starving the payroll or leaving wounded veterans behind drives mercenaries to pack their kits.
